Identify each before buying machinery. Check this orientation when you have located those pages. This is a manual reading acknowledgement, not a detector for opening the guide. You are free to explore other schools afterward.

In Hermetica, use Getting Started and Spagyrics' heat instructions to check spacing and accepted fuels. Task: possess the Brazier; FTB does not verify that a machine has heated up.

The tagged source example grants three Mineral Salt for a qualifying ore; this is not a promise of universal ore doubling. Task: acquire the oven. Check a real output in-game yourself.

quests.title: Collect Sal Ammoniac

Supply stored Sal Ammoniac and an eligible source—an Oak Log is a useful beginner example—and retrieve its identity-specific Alchemical Sulfur. Check Liquefaction in JEI and Hermetica for the amount; many ordinary logs use 10 mB in tagged source. This is not generic Sulfur interchangeable between all targets. Quest task checks acquisition of the cauldron, not that liquefaction happened.

Fill each vessel with its own material class. The task detects an Incubator item only; placement, correct adjacency and heating must be checked in-world.

Abundant, Common, Rare and Precious are Niter categories, not the Stone/Iron/Diamond/Netherite divination-rod levels. Checkmark is manual: verify the real resulting Niter yourself.

quests.description: This optional knowledge milestone explains a real safety boundary, not a required Nether Star or Dragon Egg kill. First acquire the original boss item legitimately.
